Only games designated by the NFL as Week 6 of the 2026-27 regular season count.

In the event of a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player with a higher interception percentage (interceptions thrown divided by pass attempts) in Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the player with fewer passing touchdowns in Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve to "Other".
